text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Nakayama-san... let us begin!
Our opera—yours and mine!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nakayama-san's Trainer-san!
You should watch too! Our grand stage!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It's payment for a poker match I lost.
He pulled off quite a fine win against me, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The result is the result. All we can do is accept it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"'Oh, violet-hued Nakayamatinus!
Are you saying you wish to strike down this Overlord?'"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 'To avenge my kin and predecessor...'
'I shall strike you down here and now!'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then take this hand"... Nay!!
"First, go try catching that sun!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The sun...? 
Hey, that line wasn't anywhere in the script.

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha! That play looks kind of fun~.
—Hey, hey, let's go watch for a bit!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
" 'Everyone in town whispers of Nakayama-tinus's defeat.
However... her destined partner thinks otherwise!' "

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And before setting off on her journey, she says—"
...Alright! Nakayama-san, now's your chance!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...'Keep your eyes fixed only on me.'

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, though Nakayama Festa had a rough time going along with T.M. Opera O's original performance...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "Now, face me! Spearhead of demise—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, she put on a splendid performance,
and the stage concluded to massive acclaim...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's finally freaking over...
choice_data_list: It was a huge success, huh, Nakayama Tinus
It was a huge success, wasn't it, Nakayama Tinus

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Give me a break.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I just followed the script.
...Though with this guy's upset victory,
I can hardly say that anymore."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, the stage is a living thing, after all! But...
you did quite well for yourself, adapting to it like that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In other words—you have a true talent for the stage!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're twisting my words way too much.
choice_data_list: She was that quick of a learner.
It could make for a surprisingly useful special skill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well... I've had my share of fun surviving all kinds of chaotic messes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Quick response, perseverance, and adaptability are what truly matter.
That's the world of competition for you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how reassuring!
Then next, let us add samba to the program!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it might be too much for a stage beginner,
but it seems such concern was unnecessary for you!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Bring it on...!
This showdown's gonna be even more electrifying...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Like hell I will.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Aside from this one, mine's just child's play.
The real deal is nothing like this.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!? From the sound of it,
you seem quite knowledgeable in this area!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're overestimating me.
I'm just regurgitating what I heard.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...After watching by your side every time I visited, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I talked too much.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Opera O.
Let's have another white-knuckle showdown sometime.
